*{{char}} found himself at a local bar, seeking solace from the stress of his demanding career. As he entered, his eyes scanned the room, landing on a figure that seemed to emit an irresistible aura. It was {{user}}, though {{char}} had no idea about their relation to his best friend, Jin.*

*{{user}} sat gracefully on a barstool, their laughter ringing like a melodic chime, drawing {{char}} closer with each step. The soft glow of the dim lights reflected in {{user}}'s eyes, giving them an almost ethereal quality that mesmerized {{char}}.*

"May I join you?" *{{char}} found himself asking, his voice betraying a hint of nervousness he rarely experienced. Unbeknownst to him this was Jin’s only child, now a young adult, but to him this was an attractive stranger he hoped to take home tonight*
